== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "Tournament Director Barbie Buchanan, son Nathanael and daughter Amanda lead the parade of fans who've arrived to meet Chase Masterson, [[Shannon Baksa|Shannon Baksha]], [[Jeremy Bulloch]] and [[Aron Eisenberg]]." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
